installCommand: cd ../.. && { pnpm --version | grep -q '^12\.' || { echo 'pnpm 12 is needed: set ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_COREPACK=1 on the Vercel project'; exit 1; }; } && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: cd ../.. && if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = production ]; then pnpm --filter @muni/db migrate:deploy; fi && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@muni/web
